questions.stem: Work out $\dfrac{2}{5} + \dfrac{1}{4}$. Give your answer as a single fraction in its simplest form.
markscheme: M1: common denominator 20 with both fractions converted ($\dfrac{8}{20}$ and $\dfrac{5}{20}$ seen)
questions.modelAnswer: The lowest common denominator of 5 and 4 is 20, so $\dfrac{2}{5} = \dfrac{8}{20}$ and $\dfrac{1}{4} = \dfrac{5}{20}$. Adding: $\dfrac{8}{20} + \dfrac{5}{20} = \dfrac{13}{20}$, which is already in its simplest form. Answer: $\dfrac{13}{20}$.

questions.stem: Two angles on a straight line are $74^\circ$ and $x^\circ$. Work out $x$.
markscheme: M1: uses angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$
questions.modelAnswer: Angles on a straight line add up to $180^\circ$, so $x = 180 - 74 = 106$. Answer: $x = 106$.

questions.stem: Solve the simultaneous equations $2x + 3y = 18$ and $x - y = 4$.
markscheme: M1: valid elimination or substitution setup (e.g. multiplying the second equation by 3)
M1: correct solution of one variable ($x = 6$ or $y = 2$)

questions.stem: A cylinder has radius $3$ cm and height $10$ cm. Work out its volume, giving your answer to 3 significant figures.
markscheme: M1: substitutes into $V = \pi r^2 h$ ($\pi \times 9 \times 10$ seen)
questions.modelAnswer: $V = \pi r^2 h = \pi \times 3^2 \times 10 = 90\pi = 282.74\ldots$ cm$^3$. To 3 significant figures: $283$ cm$^3$.

questions.stem: Ten students recorded how many books they read last month: three students read $2$ books, five students read $3$ books and two students read $4$ books. Work out the mean number of books read.
questions.modelAnswer: Total books $= 2 \times 3 + 3 \times 5 + 4 \times 2 = 6 + 15 + 8 = 29$. Total students $= 3 + 5 + 2 = 10$. Mean $= 29 \div 10 = 2.9$ books.

questions.stem: A rectangle measures $7.4$ cm by $3.2$ cm, each correct to 1 decimal place. Work out the upper bound of the area of the rectangle. Give your answer to 3 significant figures.
markscheme: B1: both upper bounds stated ($7.45$ and $3.25$)
M1: multiplies the two upper bounds
questions.modelAnswer: Upper bounds: $7.45$ cm and $3.25$ cm. Maximum area $= 7.45 \times 3.25 = 24.2125$ cm$^2$, which is $24.2$ cm$^2$ to 3 significant figures.

questions.stem: Solve the quadratic equation $2x^2 - 5x - 3 = 0$ by factorisation.
markscheme: M1: valid factorisation attempt with product $-6$ and sum $-5$ identified
M1: sets each factor to zero
questions.modelAnswer: We need two numbers with product $2 \times -3 = -6$ and sum $-5$: they are $-6$ and $1$. So $2x^2 - 6x + x - 3 = 2x(x - 3) + 1(x - 3) = (2x + 1)(x - 3) = 0$. Hence $x = -\dfrac{1}{2}$ or $x = 3$.
